name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Existence(target_room_entered) is redundant — the hard Existence(target_picked_up) with the hard Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) already forces the room to be entered before the ball is picked up. Remove Existence(target_room_entered); keep Existence(target_picked_up) and Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard requires the ball pickup, and Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) hard encodes 'get into the locked room' before picking up; together they also force entering the room, so no extra Existence is needed.

texts: The agent must eventually pick up the ball.
The target room must be entered before the ball is picked up.
